## Professional Profile

I am an Economics and Politics graduate from the University of Essex with a strong interest in analytical problem-solving, research, strategy, and evidence-based decision-making.

This website presents a selection of my academic work, professional experience, and project-based learning, highlighting my ability to analyse information, communicate clearly, and apply structured thinking across different contexts.

## Areas of Focus

This portfolio is designed for employers, recruiters, and academic/professional contacts who want to understand my background beyond a CV. It highlights my analytical skills, project work, professional experience, and interest in applying structured thinking to real-world problems.
